+# S6-02a — Frozen verification and exact read
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after fresh independent review. Size M, two phases maximum. Branch `task/S6-02a-verification-core` from merged main; coordinator commits plan. Depends on merged S6-01a, S3, S4 Finding, S4-05a resolver; consume S4-05b if merged. Migration is **new** after main's `0018_finding_match_deferral` (`backend/migrations/versions/0018_finding_match_deferral.py:22-23`); recheck head before coding. Authority: `.agent/architect-A-S6-verification-answers.md`, `D-2026-10-16-s6-verification` (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:4155`), lifecycle/S6-01 store/reopen decisions (`:4123,4145,4152`) and both architecture reviews.
+
+## Persisted trial and evaluation
+
+Own `D-verification-window`, `I-sim-verification-cases`, `I-verification-plan-read`, `I-verification-read`, `I-action-evidence-read`. Add **new** append-only plan revision, baseline day-selection rows, later selection binding, evaluation request, outcome, lineage and metric rows as needed. Same-Site FKs, server recorded time, immutable payload digest/idempotency keys, exact `(recorded_at,id)` history and cutoff selection. Plan version `reserve-trial-verification-1` requires APPLIED Action and committed change. SYSTEM demonstration capability may freeze plan/request evaluation with service/job/fixture provenance; it cannot submit verdict/metric/event. Evaluator job alone appends resolution events in its serialized transaction. No gateway/local username is human author. Identical evaluation retries return same outcome ID; changed basis appends superseding outcome; exact prior IDs/cutoffs remain readable.
+
+Freeze before later run or first later accepted report: Action, origin FindingRevision, APPLIED event, old/new covering FoundationRevision, baseline selected S3 assessment/run and accepted IDs, model/cohort/clock/source basis, target, guardrails, bands, coverage and two explicit half-open 60-minute UTC windows. Baseline ends before new effective_from; later starts at/after it; neither straddles a policy change. Same clock hour/duration/Site/asset/model/signal roles. Supersede a pending plan only before later acceptance; afterward a new attempt needs new plan and later window. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.
+
+Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.
+
+**Serialization:** replace S6-01a accept's Finding-scoped lock/read (`backend/assetops_backend/actions/adapters/postgres_action_store.py:205-232`) with **one** `(tenant,Site,asset,field,rule)` trial lock shared by accept and evaluator. Guard reads all prior Actions at that scope and checks current outcome/event atomically on POST, even for a different Finding. Test a different Finding on same battery denied after guardrail failure and overlap. Preserve identical accept retry and Action/Site publish lock order. Migrate `action_event` kind, triggering-command, command-key, source-channel CHECKs (`backend/migrations/versions/0016_action_store.py:123-162`) for evaluator SYSTEM job events; update `lifecycle.reduce` and `service.is_unresolved` (`backend/assetops_backend/actions/lifecycle.py:64`, `actions/service.py:57`) from latest ordered resolution/withdrawal. Action adapter remains sole Action SQL writer. Add **new verification tables** to statement-level rule-8 writer entries; reject writes elsewhere and mutation (`tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1:708-709,770-812,1011`).
+
+## API, fixture and review
+
+Add **new** Site-scoped exact plan, evaluation request/status, outcome/history, required/accepted evidence reads under `/api/sites/{site_code}/actions/{action_id}/verification/...`; selected plan/outcome IDs or recorded cutoff, typed selector conflict, 401/403/404. Return every target/guardrail, coverage/slot gap, comparability, source resolution, currentness, known failure and limitation with IDs. Action/Recommendation/Change reads expose current verification state and typed prior-trial block while retaining S6-01 pinned history. Commit **new** versioned API fixture tested against persisted responses for S6-02b.
+
+Produce **new** replayable `D-verification-window` manifest: two separate fixed-policy registered Lab runs, old then new Foundation, ordinary gateway/S2 acceptance, public run/batch/envelope IDs, expected S3/S4/plan/outcome IDs; private oracle only in Lab. Cases: complete pass; target miss; target pass with measured reserve/service failure; missing critical role or terminal SOC; contradictory/late evidence with REASSESSMENT_PENDING then appended settled outcome; closed-window zero Finding basis; different-Finding hold and permanent overlap. Every example says simulated policy trial and no savings claim.
+

+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Migration, roles/profile, frozen plan/selection and exact plan/evidence read | New Postgres immutability/idempotency/FK, APPLIED precondition, bounds, slots/readiness, S3 day-selection/cross-midnight/open-bound tests; adjacent `test_s3_dispatch_assessment_postgres.py`, `test_s1_bindings_postgres.py`. |
+| 2 and slice review | Evaluator, source/work gates, history, atomic resolution/holds, API fixture and replay | New Postgres/API cases for every verdict/guardrail, per-window provenance, pending/late/backdated Foundation, same/different Finding races, exact cutoff/retry, 401/403/404; adjacent S4 Finding/schedule and `test_s6_action_apply_postgres.py`; rule-8 guard cases; private DB run→accept→reload. |
+
+Fresh independent phase reviews; phase 2 is slice review. Focused tests each phase. On final revision run `tools/check-all.ps1`, registry checker and **one** real-Postgres full suite with `_test` URL, `pytest backend/tests -n 2 --dist loadfile --no-loadscope-reorder -q --durations=30 --junitxml=.pytest-junit.xml`, keep-awake, 20-minute cap, JUnit zero skipped/failed (`backend/TESTING.md:7-31,91-153`). Hand exact fixture IDs/API responses/test revision to UI implementer.

+## Checked code reality and Architect questions
+
+S3 day selection `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/assessment_worker.py:62-69`, `dispatch_read.py:67,123-149`; segment/interval `dispatch_v3.py:343-472` (OPEN_BOUND `:452-456`). Roles `sites/binding_roles.py:18-25,49-82`; Lab roles-2 profile `runs/profiles.py:1856`. +Architect questions before build: (1) choose numeric comparable load/PV/initial-SOC bands; recommend explicit fixture-calibrated bands frozen in plan, fail closed outside. (2) choose accepted five-minute slot integration/boundary sample convention for power/SOC; recommend exact UTC slot intervals with duration-weighted energy and terminal reading at half-open end. (3) clarify whether pre-acceptance plan replacement may reuse windows; recommend new plan ID/supersedes and only before later acceptance. No fixture oracle or UI chooses these at evaluation time.

Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+

Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.

VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.

Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. +# S6-02a — Frozen verification and exact read
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after fresh independent review. Size M, two phases maximum. Branch `task/S6-02a-verification-core` from merged main; coordinator commits plan. Depends on merged S6-01a, S3, S4 Finding, S4-05a resolver; consume S4-05b if merged. Migration is **new** after main's `0018_finding_match_deferral` (`backend/migrations/versions/0018_finding_match_deferral.py:22-23`); recheck head before coding. Authority: `.agent/architect-A-S6-verification-answers.md`, `D-2026-10-16-s6-verification` (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:4155`), lifecycle/S6-01 store/reopen decisions (`:4123,4145,4152`) and both architecture reviews.
+
+## Persisted trial and evaluation
+
+Own `D-verification-window`, `I-sim-verification-cases`, `I-verification-plan-read`, `I-verification-read`, `I-action-evidence-read`. Add **new** append-only plan revision, baseline day-selection rows, later selection binding, evaluation request, outcome, lineage and metric rows as needed. Same-Site FKs, server recorded time, immutable payload digest/idempotency keys, exact `(recorded_at,id)` history and cutoff selection. Plan version `reserve-trial-verification-1` requires APPLIED Action and committed change. SYSTEM demonstration capability may freeze plan/request evaluation with service/job/fixture provenance; it cannot submit verdict/metric/event. Evaluator job alone appends resolution events in its serialized transaction. No gateway/local username is human author. Identical evaluation retries return same outcome ID; changed basis appends superseding outcome; exact prior IDs/cutoffs remain readable.
+
+Freeze before later run or first later accepted report: Action, origin FindingRevision, APPLIED event, old/new covering FoundationRevision, baseline selected S3 assessment/run and accepted IDs, model/cohort/clock/source basis, target, guardrails, bands, coverage and two explicit half-open 60-minute UTC windows. Baseline ends before new effective_from; later starts at/after it; neither straddles a policy change. Same clock hour/duration/Site/asset/model/signal roles. Supersede a pending plan only before later acceptance; afterward a new attempt needs new plan and later window. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.
+
+Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.
+
+**Serialization:** replace S6-01a accept's Finding-scoped lock/read (`backend/assetops_backend/actions/adapters/postgres_action_store.py:205-232`) with **one** `(tenant,Site,asset,field,rule)` trial lock shared by accept and evaluator. Guard reads all prior Actions at that scope and checks current outcome/event atomically on POST, even for a different Finding. Test a different Finding on same battery denied after guardrail failure and overlap. Preserve identical accept retry and Action/Site publish lock order. Migrate `action_event` kind, triggering-command, command-key, source-channel CHECKs (`backend/migrations/versions/0016_action_store.py:123-162`) for evaluator SYSTEM job events; update `lifecycle.reduce` and `service.is_unresolved` (`backend/assetops_backend/actions/lifecycle.py:64`, `actions/service.py:57`) from latest ordered resolution/withdrawal. Action adapter remains sole Action SQL writer. Add **new verification tables** to statement-level rule-8 writer entries; reject writes elsewhere and mutation (`tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1:708-709,770-812,1011`).
+
+## API, fixture and review
+
+Add **new** Site-scoped exact plan, evaluation request/status, outcome/history, required/accepted evidence reads under `/api/sites/{site_code}/actions/{action_id}/verification/...`; selected plan/outcome IDs or recorded cutoff, typed selector conflict, 401/403/404. Return every target/guardrail, coverage/slot gap, comparability, source resolution, currentness, known failure and limitation with IDs. Action/Recommendation/Change reads expose current verification state and typed prior-trial block while retaining S6-01 pinned history. Commit **new** versioned API fixture tested against persisted responses for S6-02b.
+
+Produce **new** replayable `D-verification-window` manifest: two separate fixed-policy registered Lab runs, old then new Foundation, ordinary gateway/S2 acceptance, public run/batch/envelope IDs, expected S3/S4/plan/outcome IDs; private oracle only in Lab. Cases: complete pass; target miss; target pass with measured reserve/service failure; missing critical role or terminal SOC; contradictory/late evidence with REASSESSMENT_PENDING then appended settled outcome; closed-window zero Finding basis; different-Finding hold and permanent overlap. Every example says simulated policy trial and no savings claim.

Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.

Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.

Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.

+# S6-02a — Frozen verification and exact read
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after fresh independent review. Size M, two phases maximum. Branch `task/S6-02a-verification-core` from merged main; coordinator commits plan. Depends on merged S6-01a, S3, S4 Finding, S4-05a resolver; consume S4-05b if merged. Migration is **new** after main's `0018_finding_match_deferral` (`backend/migrations/versions/0018_finding_match_deferral.py:22-23`); recheck head before coding. Authority: `.agent/architect-A-S6-verification-answers.md`, `D-2026-10-16-s6-verification` (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:4155`), lifecycle/S6-01 store/reopen decisions (`:4123,4145,4152`) and both architecture reviews.
+
+## Persisted trial and evaluation
+
+Own `D-verification-window`, `I-sim-verification-cases`, `I-verification-plan-read`, `I-verification-read`, `I-action-evidence-read`. Add **new** append-only plan revision, baseline day-selection rows, later selection binding, evaluation request, outcome, lineage and metric rows as needed. Same-Site FKs, server recorded time, immutable payload digest/idempotency keys, exact `(recorded_at,id)` history and cutoff selection. Plan version `reserve-trial-verification-1` requires APPLIED Action and committed change. SYSTEM demonstration capability may freeze plan/request evaluation with service/job/fixture provenance; it cannot submit verdict/metric/event. Evaluator job alone appends resolution events in its serialized transaction. No gateway/local username is human author. Identical evaluation retries return same outcome ID; changed basis appends superseding outcome; exact prior IDs/cutoffs remain readable.
+
+Freeze before later run or first later accepted report: Action, origin FindingRevision, APPLIED event, old/new covering FoundationRevision, baseline selected S3 assessment/run and accepted IDs, model/cohort/clock/source basis, target, guardrails, bands, coverage and two explicit half-open 60-minute UTC windows. Baseline ends before new effective_from; later starts at/after it; neither straddles a policy change. Same clock hour/duration/Site/asset/model/signal roles. Supersede a pending plan only before later acceptance; afterward a new attempt needs new plan and later window. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.
+
+Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.
+
+**Serialization:** replace S6-01a accept's Finding-scoped lock/read (`backend/assetops_backend/actions/adapters/postgres_action_store.py:205-232`) with **one** `(tenant,Site,asset,field,rule)` trial lock shared by accept and evaluator. Guard reads all prior Actions at that scope and checks current outcome/event atomically on POST, even for a different Finding. Test a different Finding on same battery denied after guardrail failure and overlap. Preserve identical accept retry and Action/Site publish lock order. Migrate `action_event` kind, triggering-command, command-key, source-channel CHECKs (`backend/migrations/versions/0016_action_store.py:123-162`) for evaluator SYSTEM job events; update `lifecycle.reduce` and `service.is_unresolved` (`backend/assetops_backend/actions/lifecycle.py:64`, `actions/service.py:57`) from latest ordered resolution/withdrawal. Action adapter remains sole Action SQL writer. Add **new verification tables** to statement-level rule-8 writer entries; reject writes elsewhere and mutation (`tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1:708-709,770-812,1011`).

+# S6-02a — Frozen verification and exact read
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after fresh independent review. Size M, two phases maximum. +## Persisted trial and evaluation
+
+Own `D-verification-window`, `I-sim-verification-cases`, `I-verification-plan-read`, `I-verification-read`, `I-action-evidence-read`. Add **new** append-only plan revision, baseline day-selection rows, later selection binding, evaluation request, outcome, lineage and metric rows as needed. Same-Site FKs, server recorded time, immutable payload digest/idempotency keys, exact `(recorded_at,id)` history and cutoff selection. Plan version `reserve-trial-verification-1` requires APPLIED Action and committed change. SYSTEM demonstration capability may freeze plan/request evaluation with service/job/fixture provenance; it cannot submit verdict/metric/event. Evaluator job alone appends resolution events in its serialized transaction. No gateway/local username is human author. Identical evaluation retries return same outcome ID; changed basis appends superseding outcome; exact prior IDs/cutoffs remain readable.
+
+Freeze before later run or first later accepted report: Action, origin FindingRevision, APPLIED event, old/new covering FoundationRevision, baseline selected S3 assessment/run and accepted IDs, model/cohort/clock/source basis, target, guardrails, bands, coverage and two explicit half-open 60-minute UTC windows. Baseline ends before new effective_from; later starts at/after it; neither straddles a policy change. Same clock hour/duration/Site/asset/model/signal roles. Supersede a pending plan only before later acceptance; afterward a new attempt needs new plan and later window. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.
+
+Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.

+
+Own `D-verification-window`, `I-sim-verification-cases`, `I-verification-plan-read`, `I-verification-read`, `I-action-evidence-read`. Plan version `reserve-trial-verification-1` requires APPLIED Action and committed change. SYSTEM demonstration capability may freeze plan/request evaluation with service/job/fixture provenance; it cannot submit verdict/metric/event. Evaluator job alone appends resolution events in its serialized transaction. No gateway/local username is human author. Identical evaluation retries return same outcome ID; changed basis appends superseding outcome; exact prior IDs/cutoffs remain readable.

Baseline ends before new effective_from; later starts at/after it; neither straddles a policy change. Same clock hour/duration/Site/asset/model/signal roles. Supersede a pending plan only before later acceptance; afterward a new attempt needs new plan and later window. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.

+Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.

Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.

Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. +## Persisted trial and evaluation
+
+Own `D-verification-window`, `I-sim-verification-cases`, `I-verification-plan-read`, `I-verification-read`, `I-action-evidence-read`. Evaluator job alone appends resolution events in its serialized transaction. No gateway/local username is human author. Identical evaluation retries return same outcome ID; changed basis appends superseding outcome; exact prior IDs/cutoffs remain readable.

Supersede a pending plan only before later acceptance; afterward a new attempt needs new plan and later window. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.

+Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.
+
+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.

+Every required five-minute slot in both windows needs accepted generator state/power, load, PV, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof, with no material rejected/overlapping/contradictory span. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere.
+
+Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched slots; later <= baseline. SOC and reserve must be accepted throughout; later below-reserve minutes = 0 and <= baseline. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after declared comparable initial-SOC band. Predeclared load/PV/other bands must pass; unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.
+
+Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.
+
+Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. Settled evaluation appends exact new assessment, FindingRevision, accepted SourceEnvelope IDs/digests, source resolutions, values and supersedes link. Final current VERIFIED or INEFFECTIVE appends RESOLVED with outcome/plan/result. Pending/reassessment/INCONCLUSIVE retain unresolved hold. Measured reserve/service GUARDRAIL_FAIL closes trial but blocks `reserve-trial-1` at (tenant,Site,battery asset,reserve field,rule) with `PRIOR_TRIAL_GUARDRAIL_FAILED` and Action/outcome link. VERIFIED and target-miss-only INEFFECTIVE release ordinary hold; next trial still needs fresh supported FindingRevision/current Foundation. Invalidated closure appends RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN and restores guard. Detected closure/late-reading acceptance overlap permanently blocks acceptance with `PRIOR_TRIAL_REASSESSMENT_OVERLAP` and links; no reviewer override here.
